mapper.select: SELECT cs.id AS sessionId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, DATE_FORMAT(cs.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS sessionDate, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(cs.start_time, '%H:%i'), '-', DATE_FORMAT(cs.end_time, '%H:%i')) AS classTime, IFNULL(session_student_count.student_count, 0) AS totalStudents, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS presentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = #{earlyLeaveStatusCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS earlyLeaveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.attendance_status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS leaveCount, srv.term_id AS termId, te.term_name AS termName FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_educl_term te ON te.id = srv.term_id AND te.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.session_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS student_count FROM t_as_enrollment e INNER JOIN t_as_student stu ON e.student_id = stu.id AND stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.register_status = 1 WHERE e.is_valid = 1 AND e.session_id IS NOT NULL AND e.enroll_status IN (1, 3) GROUP BY e.session_id ) session_student_count ON cs.id = session_student_count.session_id LEFT JOIN t_as_attendance_record ar ON ar.session_id = cs.id AND ar.is_valid = 1 AND ar.target_type = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cc.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND cc.id = #{query.courseClassId} GROUP BY cs.id, cc.course_class_name, session_student_count.student_count, cs.session_date, cs.start_time, cs.end_time, srv.term_id, te.term_name ORDER BY cs.session_date ASC, cs.start_time ASC

SELECT cs.id AS sessionId, srv.term_id AS termId, te.term_name AS termName, cs.session_date AS sessionDate, sp.section_no AS sectionNo, sp.section_name AS sectionName, CASE cs.week_day WHEN 1 THEN '周一' WHEN 2 THEN '周二' WHEN 3 THEN '周三' WHEN 4 THEN '周四' WHEN 5 THEN '周五' WHEN 6 THEN '周六' WHEN 7 THEN '周日' ELSE '未知' END AS weekDayName, cs.start_time AS startTime, cs.end_time AS endTime, t.teacher_name AS teacherName FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_service srv ON cc.service_id = srv.id AND srv.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_term te ON srv.term_id = te.id AND te.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_schedule_period sp ON cs.schedule_period_id = sp.id AND sp.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_teacher t ON cs.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cc.id = #{query.courseClassId} AND cc.school_id = #{query.schoolId} ORDER BY cs.session_date ASC, cs.start_time ASC
